name: chatos-document-mcp
description: Inspect, validate, render, and safely operate Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files inside a bound ChatOS workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Local Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF tools
interface.longDescription: Inspects, validates, renders, creates, edits, and converts documents on the Local Connector Client while restricting input to the bound workspace and output to managed artifacts.
capabilities: Offline Office to image-based PDF conversion
defaultPrompt: Inspect a document before editing it.
Use only relative workspace paths or relativePath values returned by this plugin.
Created and edited files are downloadable managed artifacts, not files written into the project workspace. Do not claim that they were saved into the project tree.

permissions.reason: Launch the installed document MCP executable.
Read explicitly referenced documents inside the bound project workspace.
Create new and edited documents, converted PDFs, rendered page images, and render manifests in the managed plugin artifact directory.
